definitions.explanation: An informal, affectionate term for one's grandmother.
An informal way to refer to an elderly woman in general.

examples.japanese: おばあちゃんの{家|いえ}に{行|い}く。
おばあちゃんがケーキを{焼|や}いてくれた。
examples.english: Grandma baked a cake for me.

examples.japanese: {夏休|なつやす}みに{田舎|いなか}のおばあちゃんに{会|あ}いに{行|い}きました。
examples.english: During summer vacation, I went to visit my grandmother in the countryside.

examples.japanese: {近所|きんじょ}のおばあちゃんはいつも{元気|げんき}だ。
examples.english: The old lady in the neighborhood is always energetic.

examples.japanese: {駅|えき}でおばあちゃんの{荷物|にもつ}を{持|も}ってあげた。
examples.english: I helped carry an elderly woman's bags at the station.

notes:
FORMALITY:
おばあちゃん is informal and affectionate. More formal equivalents:
・おばあさん (polite)
・{祖母|そぼ} (formal/written, used when referring to one's own grandmother to others)
・{お祖母|おばあ}さま (very polite/respectful)

RELATED FAMILY TERMS:
・おじいちゃん (grandfather, informal)
・おばあさん (grandmother, polite)
・{祖母|そぼ} (grandmother, formal)
・{祖父|そふ} (grandfather, formal)
